steps.name: world tree behind
steps.objective: Go to the “Infinite Corridor” and talk to [Ritania], then defeat [Dark Unicorn], [Dark Pegasus], and [Black Giselle] in the “Twisted World Tree”.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: You're here! Since the situation is very urgent, I will get straight to the point.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: First, let me tell you about the characteristics of where we are… .

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: This is a hidden world.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: It is also called by various names such as shadow, beyond the mirror, and the inner world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fascinating. The world behind it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't know until now.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: It has to be that way. Very few people know of its existence, and access is strictly controlled.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: If even one side is out of balance, both sides will suffer great damage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is in control?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: The Gendia continent is controlled by a special agency directly under the Empress... .

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: We, the Temple of Ceres, control Prayos and other areas.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Since the temple is currently short of hands, I ended up borrowing the power of Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. So what specifically happened?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Something has distorted space and time, and demon energy is being released there.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Construction? Magi?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: The demon world has a very dark energy.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: It can even change the essence of a certain living thing.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: If this place is completely contaminated with demon energy, the original world tree will be in great danger.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Because you said that if one side loses balance, both sides become dangerous?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: That's right. It's the same place after all.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: I will find the cause, so please kill the creatures infected with demon energy.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: If we don't clean it up quickly, something big will happen.

steps.name: Reason for Magi
steps.objective: Defeat [Dark Wizard Disciple] and [Red Wizard Disciple] in “Twisted World Tree”.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: I found out the cause.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: This happened when the warlock's disciples tried to summon a demon but failed.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Summoning a demon?

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Why? And why did that happen here... ?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Warlocks are public enemies.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: To dangerous beings from the Demon World or other worlds... .

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: They are a people who use their souls as collateral to gain power and commit ugly acts.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Not only our temple, but also various powers keep strict watch over it.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: It seems like he was trying to gain greater power by summoning demons... .

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: It seems to me that the timing was bad.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Bad timing?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Demigod Velosh moved the location of the World Tree.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: As a result, the wizards who sneaked in lost their way back... .

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: At the same time, the summoning ritual also failed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Anyway, now that we know the cause, we can solve it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Can you help me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will help you in any way I can.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Then, use Adventurer’s skills to drive away the bad energy inside.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Yes, if that's the case, I'll resolve it soon.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: I hope you finish well. Hehehe.

steps.name: Cleanup work begins
steps.objective: After talking to [Ritania], defeat [Mutant Blue Dragon] in '"Twisted World Tree".

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ritania, you worked hard too.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Other than a little bit of purification, I didn't have to go through much trouble.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Oh, there's one more thing I'd like to ask you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please speak.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Please keep the secret world behind the scenes.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: It is also a world that is strictly controlled… .

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: If many people find out, the world will eventually become crowded.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Besides that, there are many other risks… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Anyway, thank you very much.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Please leave the rest to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you need any help, please contact us anytime!
